geographyReview.countyPolicy: Active original publisher FIPS plus independent current county alias and primary postal state. Exactly one leading zero may be restored to four-digit numeric FIPS; no missing/retired county reassignment. Two-code STATE must equal BORD_RIV and include primary postal state.
geographyReview.materialContradictionFinding: No material county contradiction established. Seventeen distinct site diagnostics fall outside the generalized publisher polygon, all below 0.8 km; these do not override exact publisher county/name/state. Original river/hydrology fields accompany every site.
